final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.h, s1.total_scans, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avg_ratio > s2.overall
